title: Weapon
description: Technology-neutral definition of a weapon item in GUMFALL. Weapons are defined by their physical form, material, craftsmanship, and provenance — not by stat floors tied to player level. Item identity is source-grounded (Core Pillar 8).

id.description: Unique identifier for this weapon definition. Use kebab-case.

material.description: Primary material of this weapon. VERIFIED material bands apply (1-10 natural/copper/bronze, etc.).

level_band.description: Level range within which this weapon is appropriate. Must align with VERIFIED material band table.

damage_types.description: VERIFIED damage types this weapon deals.

base_force.description: Base Force value used in the Attack Energy formula: Attack Energy = Base Force × Motion × Attribute × Ability Modifier.

reach.description: Qualitative reach classification for gameplay purposes.

enchantments.description: Enchantments present on this weapon instance. Natural weapons can have 0-3 enchantments; Malady is separate.

enchantment_id.description: References an enchantment defined in enchantment.schema.json.

provenance.description: Origin story of this weapon — monster drop, faction craft, region find, quest reward, etc. Supports Core Pillar 8 (source-grounded loot).
examples: Dropped by Bronze Paw militia sergeant
Crafted by Sugarforge smiths of the Caravan Quarter
Quest reward from the Sugar Guard initiation rite

condition.description: Current physical condition of the weapon.

notes.description: Internal design notes, authority labels, or open questions.
